title: Gotrade Daily: Oil Slides, ConocoPhillips and Airbnb Tonight
summary: Wall Street rallied after the midterms while oil fell more than 8%. Tonight: ConocoPhillips, jobless claims, then Airbnb and Cloudflare.
body_markdown:
Oil executives and lobbyists worry that a windfall profits tax could emerge as part of a broader deal between Democrats and President Trump,[according to Bloomberg](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-11-04/oil-sector-girds-for-possible-windfall-tax-after-democrats-win) . The tax is still only a proposal.


**ConocoPhillips ([COP](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/cop/) )** reports third-quarter results before the open,[according to the Nasdaq earnings calendar](https://www.nasdaq.com/market-activity/earnings) . ConocoPhillips and ExxonMobil shares fell on Wednesday, according to the AP.


### Qualcomm and chip stocks after the rally


**Qualcomm ([QCOM](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/qcom/) )** reported fiscal fourth-quarter 2026 revenue of $10.32 billion, down 8%, and non-GAAP earnings per share of $2.17,[according to Qualcomm's release](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000804328/000080432826000127/qcom092726erex991.htm) . Handset revenue fell 26% to $5.14 billion, while automotive rose 89% to $1.99 billion.


Qualcomm expects fiscal first-quarter 2027 revenue of $10.4 billion to $11.2 billion and non-GAAP earnings per share of $2.15 to $2.35. It also targets $5 billion in data center revenue in fiscal 2027. The shares fell 6.5% after hours,[according to CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/04/stock-market-today-live-updates.html) .


On Wednesday, chip and data center stocks lagged the rally. **Nvidia ([NVDA](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/nvda/) )** fell 3.1% and CoreWeave fell 9.9%, as investors saw the Democratic wins in Texas as possibly slowing the build-out of AI data centers, according to the AP.


### Jobs data and reports after the close


Weekly initial jobless claims are due at 8:30 a.m. ET, with a forecast of 197,000 against 194,000 the week before,[according to Investing.com's calendar](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/initial-jobless-claims-highlight-economic-data-due-thursday-93CH-5001034) . Third-quarter productivity data comes at the same time, and October nonfarm payrolls are due Friday, according to CNBC.


After the close, **Airbnb ([ABNB](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/abnb/) )** and **Cloudflare ([NET](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/net/) )** report third-quarter results, along with Monster Beverage and EOG Resources, according to the Nasdaq earnings calendar.


## Pre-Market Pulse 📊


As of 10:03 p.m. ET on Wednesday, Dow futures were up 90 points, or 0.2%, S&P 500 futures were up 0.1% and Nasdaq 100 futures were flat,[according to CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/04/stock-market-today-live-updates.html) .


After hours, **AppLovin ([APP](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/app/) )** surged almost 24% after better-than-expected results and guidance that beat estimates, according to CNBC. In Asia, a post-election stock rotation sank chipmakers and lifted automakers,[according to Bloomberg](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-11-05/blue-wave-stock-rotation-sinks-asian-chipmakers-boosts-autos) .


## Macro Note 📝


The 10-year Treasury yield fell more than 6 basis points to 4.884% and the 2-year yield fell more than 4 basis points to 4.573% on Wednesday,[according to CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/03/treasury-yields-fall-as-democrats-win-big-in-us-midterm-elections.html) .


## Conclusion


Tonight the market tests the post-election rally: energy through ConocoPhillips's report after oil's slide, chips through the reaction to Qualcomm's guidance, and the jobless claims ahead of Friday's payrolls.


The US market opens at 9:30 a.m. ET. Airbnb's and Cloudflare's results arrive only after the 4 p.m. ET close.
